definitions.explanation: A small prize given to people who took part but did not win, as at a lottery, raffle or contest.

examples.japanese: {残念賞|ざんねんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
⟦{外|はず}れ→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧くじ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{残念賞|ざんねんしょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a consolation prize for those who draw a blank.

examples.japanese: ⟦{福引|ふくび}き→福引き：17826_fukubiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{残念賞|ざんねんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧しか⟦{当|あ}たらなかった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{子|こ}ども⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{喜|よろこ}んでいた→喜ぶ：01169_yorokobu⟧。
examples.english: At the prize draw we only won the consolation tissues, but the kids were happy anyway.

notes:
At shopping-street lotteries (⟦{福引|ふくび}き→福引き：17826_fukubiki⟧) the {残念賞|ざんねんしょう} is typically a packet of tissues or a piece of candy. Also used jokingly for any small consolation after a failure.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {残念賞|ざんねんしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらう→もらう：00520_morau⟧: to receive a consolation prize
- {残念賞|ざんねんしょう}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧: as a consolation prize
- {残念賞|ざんねんしょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ティッシュ→ティッシュ：08816_tisshu⟧: consolation tissues

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{参加賞|さんかしょう}→参加賞：29989_sankashou⟧: participation prize, given to everyone who takes part
- ⟦{入賞|にゅうしょう}→入賞：11670_nyuushou⟧: placing in the prizes, an actual award
